correctness.rationale: Removing phases by a diagonal unitary reduces w_6(T) to the Schatten-6 norm of H=(T+T*)/2; for x=|a0|²,y=|a1|²,z=|a2|² and S=x+y+z, charpoly of 2H is μ⁴-Sμ²+xz, yielding exactly 32 w_6(T)^6=S³-3xzS, while ||T||_6^6=x³+y³+z³. Normalizing denominator to 1 and fixing outer cubic mass m=x³+z³ and y, write u=(x+z)/2 and eliminate asymmetry to get F=m+y³+6uy²+8u²y+my/(2u); strict convexity F_uu=16y+my/u³>0 forces one of two endpoints, xz=0 or x=z. The zero-weight boundary has F≤4, whereas all three equal weights attain F=6, excluding zero cases. For x=z>0, optimize g(r)=(r+2)(r²+4r+1)/(r³+2); direct differentiation equals -6(r⁴+3r³-4r-3)/(r³+2)². Descartes gives unique positive r* in (1,2), so equality requires outer magnitudes equal and |a1|²=r*|a0|² with all phases arbitrary. Independently checked characteristic sixth trace on rational edge triples and exact symbolic reduced identity and derivative; those checks corroborate analytic global argument.
